```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Paths are relative to the folder that contains this file. Fitted models are saved to modelPath
# and reloaded on later renders, so the slow fits run only once.
modelPath <- "Models/BetLevel/"
dir.create(modelPath, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
options(tibble.width = Inf, scipen = 99, mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())

library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(brms)
library(posterior)

map <- purrr::map
filter <- dplyr::filter
select <- dplyr::select

# Sampler settings
n_chains <- 4
n_iter <- 4000
n_iter_cv <- n_iter / 2
n_draws_pred <- 2000
cv_seed <- 2026

# Models fitted at the same time (each uses n_chains cores and about 3 to 4 GB of RAM). Parallel fitting needs Mac or Linux.
ram_gb <- tryCatch({
  if (Sys.info()[["sysname"]] == "Darwin") as.numeric(system("sysctl -n hw.memsize", intern = TRUE)) / 1e9
  else as.numeric(gsub("[^0-9]", "", readLines("/proc/meminfo", n = 1))) / 1e6
}, error = function(e) NA_real_)

n_parallel <- if (.Platform$OS.type == "windows" || is.na(ram_gb)) 1 else min(3, max(1, floor((ram_gb - 4) / 4)))
```

# About This File {.unnumbered}

This file reproduces the analyses reported in the manuscript from `Strategies1_shareable.csv`. The sections follow the order of the manuscript (Method, Results, Appendix A, Appendix B), and each table caption uses the manuscript's table number. Participants are identified only by an anonymous ID (P001 to P299).

The first render fits 11 models, 44 cross-validation fits, and the joint model in the exploratory analysis, which takes several hours on a laptop. Every fit is saved to `Models/BetLevel/`, so later renders take minutes. The internal label for the College Football Playoff slate is "CFB"; printed labels use "CFP", as in the manuscript.

# Data Preparation {.unnumbered}

```{r import}
strat <- read.csv("Strategies1_shareable.csv") %>%
  filter(Finished == TRUE) %>%
  # The participant ID column is named PROLIFIC_PID inside the code so that the formulas match the saved models.
  # In the shareable data it holds the anonymous ID.
  rename(PROLIFIC_PID = ParticipantID)

# Optional, for the authors only: a private key that maps the anonymous IDs back to the IDs used when the models
# were first fitted, so that the saved model files are reused instead of refit. Without the key, the models are fit
# from scratch with the anonymous IDs and give the same results up to Monte Carlo error.
key_file <- "Strategies1_id_key_private.csv"
if (file.exists(key_file)) {
  id_key <- read.csv(key_file)
  strat <- strat %>% mutate(PROLIFIC_PID = id_key$PROLIFIC_PID[match(PROLIFIC_PID, id_key$ParticipantID)])
  stopifnot(!anyNA(strat$PROLIFIC_PID))
}
```

```{r helpers}
is_selected <- function(x) !is.na(x) & x != "" & x != "Not place a bet"

implied_prob_from_american <- function(odds) ifelse(odds < 0, -odds / (-odds + 100), 100 / (odds + 100))

fmt2 <- function(x) formatC(round(x, 2), format = "f", digits = 2)

fmt3 <- function(x) formatC(round(x, 3), format = "f", digits = 3)

# Printed label for the college slate: the data use "CFB" internally, the manuscript uses "CFP"
cfp <- function(x) str_replace_all(x, "CFB", "CFP")
```

```{r menu}
scen_map <- tribble(~Scenario, ~ShownPrefix, ~HiddenPrefix, ~ShownBlock, ~HiddenBlock,
  "CFB", "CFP_Bets_Prob_", "CFP_Bets_Hidden_", 1, 5,
  "NFL Moneyline", "ML_Prob_Bets_", "ML_Hidden_Bets_", 2, 8,
  "NFL Spread", "Spread_Prob_Bets_", "Spread_Hidden_Bets_", 3, 7,
  "NFL Totals", "Totals_Prob_Bets_", "Totals_Hidden_Bets_", 4, 6)

scenario_levels <- scen_map$Scenario

market_levels <- c("CFB Moneyline", "CFB Spread", "CFB Totals", "NFL Moneyline", "NFL Spread", "NFL Totals")

first_label <- function(col) { v <- strat[[col]]; v <- v[!is.na(v) & v != ""]; v[1] }

team_of <- function(lbl) str_squish(str_remove(lbl, "\\s*(Spread|Moneyline|[+-]\\d+(\\.\\d+)?)?\\s*\\(.*$"))

# One row per scenario x option (option k = 2..13; k = 1 is "Not place a bet", k = 14 is "Parlay")
menu <- scen_map %>%
  select(Scenario, ShownPrefix) %>%
  crossing(k = 2:13) %>%
  mutate(Label = map2_chr(ShownPrefix, k, ~ first_label(paste0(.x, .y))),
    Odds = as.numeric(str_extract(Label, "(?<=\\()[+-]?\\d+(?=\\))")),
    ImpliedProb = implied_prob_from_american(Odds),
    BetType = case_when(Scenario == "NFL Moneyline" ~ "Moneyline", Scenario == "NFL Spread" ~ "Spread",
      Scenario == "NFL Totals" ~ "Totals", str_detect(Label, "Spread") ~ "Spread",
      str_detect(Label, "Over|Under") ~ "Totals", TRUE ~ "Moneyline"),
    League = if_else(Scenario == "CFB", "CFB", "NFL"),
    MarketType = factor(paste(League, BetType), market_levels),
    Market = (k - 2) %/% 2 + 1,
    Side = (k - 2) %% 2 + 1,
    Game = if_else(Scenario == "CFB", if_else(k <= 7, 1L, 2L), as.integer(Market)),
    Team = if_else(BetType == "Totals", NA_character_, team_of(Label)),
    SpreadLine = as.numeric(str_extract(Label, "(?<=\\s)[+-]\\d+(\\.\\d+)?(?=\\s\\()"))) %>%
  group_by(Scenario, Market) %>%
  mutate(q = ImpliedProb / sum(ImpliedProb)) %>%
  ungroup()

cfb_favorites <- menu %>%
  filter(Scenario == "CFB", BetType == "Moneyline") %>%
  group_by(Game) %>%
  slice_max(q, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Game, CFBFavorite = Team)

menu <- menu %>%
  left_join(cfb_favorites, by = "Game") %>%
  mutate(IsFavorite = case_when(BetType == "Totals" ~ NA, BetType == "Moneyline" ~ q > .5,
      Scenario == "CFB" ~ Team == CFBFavorite, TRUE ~ SpreadLine < 0),
    Favorite = case_when(is.na(IsFavorite) ~ 0, IsFavorite ~ .5, TRUE ~ -.5),
    Over = case_when(BetType != "Totals" ~ 0, str_detect(Label, "Over") ~ .5, TRUE ~ -.5),
    WinProb10 = (q - .5) * 10,
    Spread = as.numeric(BetType == "Spread"),
    Totals = as.numeric(BetType == "Totals"),
    OptionID = paste(Scenario, k),
    Scenario = factor(Scenario, scenario_levels)) %>%
  select(-ShownPrefix, -CFBFavorite)
```

```{r blocks}
parse_kv <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x) || trimws(x) == "") return(NULL)
  parts <- str_split(str_replace_all(x, "\\|+", "|"), "\\|")[[1]]
  kv <- str_split_fixed(parts[parts != ""], "=", 2)
  setNames(as.list(kv[, 2]), kv[, 1])
}

kv_num <- function(l, key) { v <- l[[key]]; if (is.null(v) || v == "") NA_real_ else as.numeric(v) }

blocks <- map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(scen_map)), function(i) {
  sm <- scen_map[i, ]
  map_dfr(seq_len(nrow(strat)), function(r) {
    shown <- parse_kv(strat[[paste0("Block", sm$ShownBlock, "_Stakes")]][r])
    hidden <- parse_kv(strat[[paste0("Block", sm$HiddenBlock, "_Stakes")]][r])
    cond <- if (!is.null(shown)) "Shown" else if (!is.null(hidden)) "Hidden" else NA_character_
    kv <- if (!is.null(shown)) shown else hidden
    prefix <- if (identical(cond, "Shown")) sm$ShownPrefix else sm$HiddenPrefix
    sel <- which(vapply(2:13, function(k) is_selected(strat[[paste0(prefix, k)]][r]), logical(1))) + 1
    stakes <- vapply(sel, function(k) { s <- kv_num(kv, paste0("Stake_", k)); ifelse(is.na(s), 0, s) }, numeric(1))
    is_parlay <- isTRUE(kv_num(kv, "IsParlay") == 1) && length(sel) >= 2
    tibble(PROLIFIC_PID = strat$PROLIFIC_PID[r], Scenario = sm$Scenario, InformationCondition = cond,
      Options = list(sel), Parlay = as.integer(is_parlay),
      TotalStake = if (is_parlay) kv_num(kv, "ParlayStake") else sum(stakes))
  })
}) %>%
  mutate(Scenario = factor(Scenario, scenario_levels), NumBets = lengths(Options))
```

```{r covariates}
  "SportsEngagementProp", "Frequency", "Typical.Bet", "Recency", "NumPlatforms", "PeerApproveNum", "PeerPercent_1", "YearBegin")
```

```{r datasets}
blocks <- blocks %>%
  filter(PROLIFIC_PID %in% persons$PROLIFIC_PID) %>%
  mutate(Block = paste(PROLIFIC_PID, Scenario, sep = "_"))

set.seed(cv_seed)

fold_key <- blocks %>%
  distinct(PROLIFIC_PID) %>%
  mutate(perm = map(PROLIFIC_PID, ~ sample(1:4))) %>%
  unnest(perm) %>%
  group_by(PROLIFIC_PID) %>%
  mutate(Scenario = factor(scenario_levels, scenario_levels)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  rename(Fold = perm)

blocks <- blocks %>% left_join(fold_key, by = c("PROLIFIC_PID", "Scenario"))

bets <- blocks %>%
  select(PROLIFIC_PID, Scenario, Block, Fold, Options, Parlay) %>%
  inner_join(menu %>% select(Scenario, k, Market, OptionID, Label, MarketType, BetType, Team, q, WinProb10, Favorite, Over, Spread, Totals),
    by = "Scenario", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
  mutate(Took = as.integer(map2_lgl(k, Options, ~ .x %in% .y)), AsParlayLeg = Took * Parlay) %>%
  select(-Options) %>%
  left_join(persons %>% select(PROLIFIC_PID, Shown, all_of(cov_names)), by = "PROLIFIC_PID")

contrasts(bets$MarketType) <- contr.sum(6)

n_both_sides <- bets %>% filter(Took == 1) %>% count(Block, Market) %>% filter(n > 1) %>% nrow()

parlay_d <- blocks %>%
  filter(NumBets >= 2) %>%
  mutate(LegWinProb = map2_dbl(Scenario, Options, ~ mean(menu$q[menu$Scenario == .x & menu$k %in% .y])),
    LegWinProb10 = (LegWinProb - .5) * 10,
    Legs = NumBets - 2) %>%
  select(-Options) %>%
  left_join(persons %>% select(PROLIFIC_PID, Shown, all_of(cov_names)), by = "PROLIFIC_PID")

contrasts(parlay_d$Scenario) <- contr.sum(4)
```

```{r tools}
priors_for <- function(f) {
  p <- prior(normal(0, 1), class = b)
  if (str_detect(f, "\\|")) p <- p + prior(exponential(1), class = sd)
  if (str_detect(f, "\\(1 \\+ [^|]+\\| PROLIFIC_PID\\)")) p <- p + prior(lkj(2), class = cor)
  p
}

fit_model <- function(f, data, name, iter = n_iter) {
  invisible(gc())
  brm(bf(as.formula(f)), data = data, family = bernoulli(), prior = priors_for(f), chains = n_chains, iter = iter,
    seed = 1, refresh = 0, init = 0, file = paste0(modelPath, name), file_refit = "on_change")
}

# Refit a full-data model on each fold's training data and predict that fold's held-out rows.
# update() reuses the compiled model, so the folds do not recompile. Fold fits are saved to modelPath;
# delete them (files ending in _foldN.rds) if the data change.
fit_fold <- function(full, train, name) {
  path <- paste0(modelPath, name, ".rds")
  if (file.exists(path)) return(readRDS(path))
  invisible(gc())
  fit <- update(full, newdata = train, recompile = FALSE, chains = n_chains, iter = n_iter_cv, seed = 1, refresh = 0, init = 0)
  saveRDS(fit, path)
  fit
}

cv_predict <- function(full, data, name, outcome) {
  map_dfr(1:4, function(fold) {
    train <- filter(data, Fold != fold)
    test <- filter(data, Fold == fold)
    fit <- fit_fold(full, train, paste0(name, "_fold", fold))
    set.seed(cv_seed + fold)  # new-level draws and draw subsampling are random; this makes them reproducible
    p <- colMeans(posterior_epred(fit, newdata = test, allow_new_levels = TRUE, sample_new_levels = "gaussian", ndraws = min(n_draws_pred, ndraws(fit))))
    tibble(row = test$row, Block = test$Block, y = test[[outcome]], p = p, p0 = mean(train[[outcome]]))
  })
}

auc <- function(y, p) {
  r <- rank(p); n1 <- sum(y == 1); n0 <- sum(y == 0)
  (sum(r[y == 1]) - n1 * (n1 + 1) / 2) / (n1 * n0)
}

loglik <- function(y, p) { p <- pmin(pmax(p, 1e-9), 1 - 1e-9); y * log(p) + (1 - y) * log(1 - p) }

cv_metrics <- function(cv) {
  cv %>%
    group_by(Model) %>%
    summarise(`CV pseudo-R²` = 1 - sum(loglik(y, p)) / sum(loglik(y, p0)), AUC = auc(y, p), .groups = "drop")
}

# Paired ELPD difference (model b minus model a), summed over held-out slips
elpd_diff <- function(cv, a, b) {
  d <- cv %>%
    filter(Model %in% c(a, b)) %>%
    group_by(Model, Block) %>%
    summarise(ll = sum(loglik(y, p)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = ll)
  dd <- d[[b]] - d[[a]]
  c(d = sum(dd), se = sqrt(length(dd)) * sd(dd))
}

# ELPD of every model relative to the best one (0 for the best), as reported by loo_compare()
elpd_vs_best <- function(cv) {
  tot <- cv %>% group_by(Model) %>% summarise(elpd = sum(loglik(y, p)), .groups = "drop")
  best <- tot$Model[which.max(tot$elpd)]
  tot %>%
    mutate(v = map(Model, ~ if (.x == best) c(d = 0, se = 0) else elpd_diff(cv, best, .x)),
      d_best = map_dbl(v, "d"), se_best = map_dbl(v, "se"), Best = Model == best) %>%
    select(-v)
}

or_ci <- function(fit, pars) {
  fe <- fixef(fit)
  fe <- fe[intersect(pars, rownames(fe)), , drop = FALSE]
  tibble(term = rownames(fe), est = fe[, "Estimate"], lo = fe[, "Q2.5"], hi = fe[, "Q97.5"]) %>%
    mutate(`OR [95% CrI]` = paste0(fmt2(exp(est)), " [", fmt2(exp(lo)), ", ", fmt2(exp(hi)), "]"), credible = lo > 0 | hi < 0)
}

# Share of between-person variance explained by covariates: 1 - tau²(with) / tau²(without), over posterior draws
r2_between <- function(fit0, fit1, par) {
  t0 <- as_draws_df(fit0)[[par]]; t1 <- as_draws_df(fit1)[[par]]
  n <- min(length(t0), length(t1))
  r <- 1 - (t1[seq_len(n)] / t0[seq_len(n)])^2
  c(med = median(r), lo = unname(quantile(r, .025)), hi = unname(quantile(r, .975)))
}

pct_ci <- function(v) paste0(round(100 * v["med"]), "% [", if_else(v["lo"] < -1, "below -100", as.character(round(100 * v["lo"]))), "%, ", round(100 * v["hi"]), "%]")

# Plain-language verdict for a paired comparison: reliable if |ΔELPD| > 2 SE
verdict <- function(cmp, which) {
  r <- cmp %>% filter(str_detect(Comparison, fixed(which)))
  v <- if (r$d > 2 * r$se) "gives a reliable improvement" else if (r$d < -2 * r$se) "makes prediction reliably worse" else "makes no reliable difference"
  paste0(v, " (ΔELPD = ", formatC(r$d, format = "f", digits = 1), ", *SE* = ", formatC(r$se, format = "f", digits = 1), ")")
}

fmt_elpd <- function(v) paste0(formatC(v["d"], format = "f", digits = 1), " (SE = ", formatC(v["se"], format = "f", digits = 1), ")")

n_iter_cv <- n_iter / 2

# Text helpers: APA numbers without a leading zero, and ready-made strings for the results text
nz <- function(x) sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", x)

r2z <- function(x) nz(fmt3(x))

d_txt <- function(cmp, which) {
  r <- cmp %>% filter(str_detect(Comparison, fixed(which)))
  paste0("ΔELPD = ", formatC(r$d, format = "f", digits = 1), ", *SE* = ", formatC(r$se, format = "f", digits = 1))
}

or_txt <- function(fit, par) {
  fe <- fixef(fit)[par, ]
  paste0("OR = ", fmt2(exp(fe["Estimate"])), ", 95% CrI [", fmt2(exp(fe["Q2.5"])), ", ", fmt2(exp(fe["Q97.5"])), "]")
}

sd_txt <- function(fit, group, par) {
  s <- VarCorr(fit)[[group]]$sd[par, ]
  paste0("SD = ", fmt2(s["Estimate"]), ", 95% CrI [", fmt2(s["Q2.5"]), ", ", fmt2(s["Q97.5"]), "]")
}

r2_med <- function(v) paste0(round(100 * v["med"]), "%")

r2_ci <- function(v) paste0("[", if (v["lo"] < -1) "< -100" else round(100 * v["lo"]), "%, ", round(100 * v["hi"]), "%]")

# Run n jobs in parallel (n_parallel at a time). A forked job can be killed when memory runs out, so any job
# that fails is rerun once on its own, in this process. If it still fails, stop and report its error message.
par_run <- function(n, f) {
  failed <- function(r) is.null(r) || inherits(r, c("error", "try-error"))
  res <- parallel::mclapply(seq_len(n), function(i) tryCatch(f(i), error = function(e) e), mc.cores = n_parallel)
  for (i in which(map_lgl(res, failed))) res[[i]] <- tryCatch(f(i), error = function(e) e)
  bad <- which(map_lgl(res, failed))
  if (length(bad) > 0) {
    msgs <- map_chr(res[bad], ~ if (inherits(.x, "error")) conditionMessage(.x) else "no result")
    stop("Job(s) ", paste(bad, collapse = ", "), " failed: ", paste(msgs, collapse = " | "), call. = FALSE)
  }
  res
}

slip_labels <- c(Legs = "Each additional leg", LegWinProb10 = "Average leg win probability (+10 points)", Shown = "Probabilities shown")

term_label <- function(x) {
  map_chr(str_split(x, ":"), function(parts) {
    lab <- c(cov_labels, WinProb10 = "win probability", Favorite = "favorite", Over = "over", Totals = "totals")[parts]
    paste(lab[order(parts %in% cov_names, decreasing = TRUE)], collapse = " × ")
  })
}

fixed_label <- function(x) {
  lab <- c(Intercept = "Intercept", menu_labels, slip_labels[c("Legs", "LegWinProb10")], cov_labels)
  map_chr(x, function(t) {
    if (str_detect(t, "^MarketType\\d+$")) return(cfp(paste0("Market type: ", levels(bets$MarketType)[as.integer(str_extract(t, "\\d+"))])))
    if (str_detect(t, "^Scenario\\d+$")) return(cfp(paste0("Slate: ", scenario_levels[as.integer(str_extract(t, "\\d+"))])))
    if (t %in% names(lab)) return(unname(lab[t]))
    if (str_detect(t, ":")) return(term_label(t))
    t
  })
}

re_rows <- function(fit) {
  vc <- tryCatch(VarCorr(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(vc)) return(tibble(Term = character(), est = numeric(), se = numeric(), lo = numeric(), hi = numeric()))
  grp_lab <- c(PROLIFIC_PID = "Participant", Block = "Slip (participant × slate)", OptionID = "Bet")
  par_lab <- c(Intercept = "intercept", WinProb10 = "win probability", Favorite = "favorite", Over = "over", Totals = "totals")
  rows <- list()
  for (g in intersect(names(grp_lab), names(vc))) {
    sdm <- vc[[g]]$sd
    for (p in rownames(sdm)) {
      rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(Term = paste0("SD: ", grp_lab[g], ", ", par_lab[p]), est = sdm[p, "Estimate"], se = sdm[p, "Est.Error"], lo = sdm[p, "Q2.5"], hi = sdm[p, "Q97.5"])
    }
    if (!is.null(vc[[g]]$cor)) {
      cm <- vc[[g]]$cor
      ps <- dimnames(cm)[[1]]
      for (i in 2:length(ps)) for (j in 1:(i - 1)) {
        v <- cm[ps[i], , ps[j]]
        rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- tibble(Term = paste0("r: ", par_lab[ps[j]], ", ", par_lab[ps[i]]), est = v["Estimate"], se = v["Est.Error"], lo = v["Q2.5"], hi = v["Q97.5"])
      }
    }
  }
  bind_rows(rows)
}

coef_table <- function(fit, caption) {
  fe <- fixef(fit)
  fixed <- tibble(Term = fixed_label(rownames(fe)), b = fmt2(fe[, "Estimate"]), SE = fmt2(fe[, "Est.Error"]),
    `95% CrI` = paste0("[", fmt2(fe[, "Q2.5"]), ", ", fmt2(fe[, "Q97.5"]), "]"), OR = fmt2(exp(fe[, "Estimate"])))
  re <- re_rows(fit)
  random <- tibble(Term = re$Term, b = fmt2(re$est), SE = fmt2(re$se), `95% CrI` = paste0("[", fmt2(re$lo), ", ", fmt2(re$hi), "]"), OR = "")
  kable(bind_rows(fixed, random), caption = caption) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE, font_size = 12) %>%
    pack_rows("Fixed effects", 1, nrow(fixed)) %>%
    {if (nrow(random) > 0) pack_rows(., "Random effects", nrow(fixed) + 1, nrow(fixed) + nrow(random)) else .} %>%
    footnote(general = coef_note(fit))
}

# Table note that mentions only the terms the model contains
coef_note <- function(fit) {
  terms <- rownames(fixef(fit))
  has <- function(p) any(str_detect(terms, p))
  vc <- tryCatch(VarCorr(fit), error = function(e) NULL)
  has_cor <- !is.null(vc) && any(map_lgl(vc, ~ !is.null(.x$cor)))
  paste(c("b = posterior mean on the log-odds scale; SE = posterior standard deviation; CrI = 95% equal-tailed credible interval; OR = exp(b).",
    if (has("^MarketType")) "Market type is sum-coded, so each estimate is a deviation from the average across market types (the last, NFL Totals, is omitted).",
    if (has("^Scenario")) "Slate is sum-coded, so each estimate is a deviation from the average across slates (the last, NFL Totals, is omitted).",
    if (has("^WinProb10|:WinProb10")) "Win probability is per 10 percentage points.",
    if (has("^LegWinProb10")) "Average leg win probability is per 10 percentage points; legs are centered at two.",
    if (has("^Favorite|^Over")) "Favorite and over are coded ±0.5.",
    if (has("^Shown")) "Probabilities shown is coded +0.5 (shown) and -0.5 (hidden).",
    if (any(terms %in% cov_names)) "Covariates are standardized; ABIS is scored so that higher values indicate more planning.",
    if (!is.null(vc)) paste0("Random effects are standard deviations (SD)", if (has_cor) " and correlations (r)" else "", " on the log-odds scale.")), collapse = " ")
}

m_sd <- function(x, d = 2) paste0(formatC(mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), format = "f", digits = d), " (", formatC(sd(x, na.rm = TRUE), format = "f", digits = d), ")")

n_pct <- function(x) paste0(sum(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE), " (", round(100 * mean(x == 1, na.rm = TRUE)), "%)")

rng <- function(x, d = 2) paste0(formatC(min(x, na.rm = TRUE), format = "f", digits = d), ", ", formatC(max(x, na.rm = TRUE), format = "f", digits = d))

pct <- function(x) paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = 1), "%")

# Lower-triangle correlation table; * = Holm-adjusted p < .05, across all correlations in the table (by = "all") or within each column (by = "col")
cor_table <- function(dat, row_vars, col_vars = row_vars, row_labels = row_vars, col_labels = col_vars, method = "pearson", by = "all") {
  grid <- expand_grid(r = row_vars, c = col_vars)
  if (identical(row_vars, col_vars)) grid <- grid %>% filter(match(c, col_vars) < match(r, row_vars))
  grid <- grid %>%
    mutate(test = map2(r, c, ~ suppressWarnings(cor.test(dat[[.x]], dat[[.y]], method = method, exact = FALSE))),
      est = map_dbl(test, "estimate"), p = map_dbl(test, "p.value")) %>%
    group_by(grp = if (by == "col") c else "all") %>%
    mutate(p_holm = p.adjust(p, "holm")) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(
      cell = paste0(sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", formatC(est, format = "f", digits = 2)), if_else(p_holm < .05, "*", "")))
  out <- matrix("", length(row_vars), length(col_vars), dimnames = list(row_labels, col_labels))
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(grid))) out[match(grid$r[i], row_vars), match(grid$c[i], col_vars)] <- grid$cell[i]
  if (identical(row_vars, col_vars)) {
    diag(out) <- ""
    out <- out[, -ncol(out), drop = FALSE]
  }
  out
}

tendency_labels <- c(BetsPerSlip = "Bets per slip", MLWinProb = "Win probability of moneyline bets",
  FavoriteShare = "Favorite share of team bets", OverShare = "Over share of totals bets",
  ParlayRate = "Parlay rate (2+ bet slips)")

tendencies <- bets %>%
  group_by(PROLIFIC_PID) %>%
  summarise(MLWinProb = mean(q[Took == 1 & BetType == "Moneyline"]),
    FavoriteShare = mean(Favorite[Took == 1 & Favorite != 0] > 0),
    OverShare = mean(Over[Took == 1 & Over != 0] > 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(blocks %>% group_by(PROLIFIC_PID) %>%
    summarise(BetsPerSlip = mean(NumBets), ParlayRate = if (any(NumBets >= 2)) sum(Parlay) / sum(NumBets >= 2) else NA_real_, .groups = "drop"),
    by = "PROLIFIC_PID") %>%
  mutate(across(-PROLIFIC_PID, ~ if_else(is.nan(.x), NA_real_, .x))) %>%
  left_join(persons_raw %>% mutate(across(c(Frequency, Typical.Bet, Recency, NumPlatforms), log1p)), by = "PROLIFIC_PID")

```

# Method

## Measures

Internal consistency of the multi-item measures in the analysis sample (Cronbach's α; KR-20 for items scored correct or incorrect and for the sports-engagement indicators).

```{r reliability}
alpha_fn <- function(x) {
  x <- x[complete.cases(x), , drop = FALSE]
  ncol(x) / (ncol(x) - 1) * (1 - sum(apply(x, 2, var)) / var(rowSums(x)))
}

sub <- strat %>% filter(PROLIFIC_PID %in% persons$PROLIFIC_PID)

rel <- c(DOSPERT = alpha_fn(select(sub, matches("^DOSPERT_\\d_num$"))),
  ABIS = alpha_fn(select(sub, matches("^BIS_\\d_num$"))),
  CRT = alpha_fn(select(sub, matches("^CRT\\d_bin$"))),
  BNT = alpha_fn(select(sub, matches("^BNT\\d_bin$"))),
  `Sports engagement` = alpha_fn(select(sub, matches("^SportsWatching_\\d+_num$")) %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(.x >= 1)))))
```

DOSPERT α = `r nz(fmt2(rel["DOSPERT"]))`; ABIS nonplanning α = `r nz(fmt2(rel["ABIS"]))`; CRT KR-20 = `r nz(fmt2(rel["CRT"]))`; BNT KR-20 = `r nz(fmt2(rel["BNT"]))`; sports engagement KR-20 = `r nz(fmt2(rel["Sports engagement"]))`.

## Participants

The analysis sample is `r nrow(persons_raw)` participants. Median completion time was `r fmt_mmss(median(dur_an))` (IQR: `r fmt_mmss(quantile(dur_an, .25))` to `r fmt_mmss(quantile(dur_an, .75))`).

## Statistical Analyses

The analysis sample has `r nrow(persons)` participants, `r format(nrow(bets), big.mark = ",")` bet decisions, and `r nrow(parlay_d)` slips with two or more bets. The models are listed in Table 2 of the manuscript. All models are fit here; their convergence diagnostics are in Appendix A (Table A1).

```{r fit-bets, results='hide'}
menu_terms <- "MarketType + WinProb10 + Favorite + Over + Shown + Shown:WinProb10"

cov_terms <- paste(cov_names, collapse = " + ")

int_terms <- paste0("(", cov_terms, "):(WinProb10 + Favorite + Over + Totals)")

re_slip <- "(1 | Block)"

re_bet <- "(1 | OptionID)"

re_person <- "(1 + WinProb10 + Favorite + Over + Totals | PROLIFIC_PID)"

bet_specs <- tribble(~Model, ~Formula,
  "M1 Menu", paste("Took ~", menu_terms, "+", re_bet, "+", re_slip),
  "M2 Covariates", paste("Took ~", cov_terms, "+", re_slip),
  "M3 Menu + covariates", paste("Took ~", menu_terms, "+", cov_terms, "+", re_bet, "+", re_slip),
  "M4 + interactions", paste("Took ~", menu_terms, "+", cov_terms, "+", int_terms, "+", re_bet, "+", re_slip),
  "M5 Menu + preferences", paste("Took ~", menu_terms, "+", re_bet, "+", re_slip, "+", re_person),
  "M6 Preferences + covariates", paste("Took ~", menu_terms, "+", cov_terms, "+", int_terms, "+", re_bet, "+", re_slip, "+", re_person)) %>%
  mutate(File = paste0("bet_", str_extract(Model, "^M\\d")))

bets <- bets %>% mutate(row = row_number())

bet_fits <- par_run(nrow(bet_specs), function(i) fit_model(bet_specs$Formula[i], bets, bet_specs$File[i])) %>% setNames(bet_specs$Model)

bet_cv <- par_run(nrow(bet_specs), function(i) cv_predict(bet_fits[[i]], bets, bet_specs$File[i], "Took") %>%
  mutate(Model = bet_specs$Model[i])) %>% bind_rows()
```

```{r fit-parlays, results='hide'}
slip_terms <- "Scenario + Legs + LegWinProb10 + Shown"

parlay_specs <- tribble(~Model, ~Formula,
  "P1 Menu", paste("Parlay ~", slip_terms),
  "P2 Covariates", paste("Parlay ~", cov_terms),
  "P3 Menu + covariates", paste("Parlay ~", slip_terms, "+", cov_terms),
  "P4 Menu + preference", paste("Parlay ~", slip_terms, "+ (1 | PROLIFIC_PID)"),
  "P5 Preference + covariates", paste("Parlay ~", slip_terms, "+", cov_terms, "+ (1 | PROLIFIC_PID)")) %>%
  mutate(File = paste0("parlay_", str_extract(Model, "^P\\d")))

parlay_d <- parlay_d %>% mutate(row = row_number())

parlay_fits <- par_run(nrow(parlay_specs), function(i) fit_model(parlay_specs$Formula[i], parlay_d, parlay_specs$File[i])) %>% setNames(parlay_specs$Model)

parlay_cv <- par_run(nrow(parlay_specs), function(i) cv_predict(parlay_fits[[i]], parlay_d, parlay_specs$File[i], "Parlay") %>%
  mutate(Model = parlay_specs$Model[i])) %>% bind_rows()
```

# Results

## Summary Statistics

```{r tab-3}
binary_vars <- c("Gender", "RaceBinary", "EducationBinary")

demo_vars <- c("Age", "Gender", "RaceBinary", "EducationBinary", "FinancialNum")

tab1_cov <- tibble(Variable = str_remove(cov_labels[cov_names], " \\(log\\)"), var = cov_names) %>%
  filter(!var %in% demo_vars) %>%
  mutate(n = nrow(persons_raw),
    `M (SD) or n (%)` = map_chr(var, ~ if (.x %in% binary_vars) n_pct(persons_raw[[.x]]) else m_sd(persons_raw[[.x]])),
    Range = map_chr(var, ~ if (.x %in% binary_vars) "" else rng(persons_raw[[.x]], if (.x %in% c("Age", "YearBegin", "Frequency", "Recency", "NumPlatforms", "Typical.Bet")) 0 else 2))) %>%
  select(-var)

n_shown <- sum(persons_raw$InformationCondition == "Shown")

tab1_tend <- tibble(Variable = tendency_labels, var = names(tendency_labels)) %>%
  mutate(n = map_int(var, ~ sum(!is.na(tendencies[[.x]]))), `M (SD) or n (%)` = map_chr(var, ~ m_sd(tendencies[[.x]])),
    Range = map_chr(var, ~ rng(tendencies[[.x]]))) %>%
  select(-var)

tab1 <- bind_rows(tab1_cov, tab1_tend)

med_iqr <- function(x, d = 1) paste0(formatC(median(x), format = "f", digits = d), " (", formatC(quantile(x, .25), format = "f", digits = d), " to ", formatC(quantile(x, .75), format = "f", digits = d), ")")

med_iqr_txt <- paste0("Bets per week ", med_iqr(persons_raw$Frequency), "; typical bet $", med_iqr(persons_raw$Typical.Bet, 0),
  "; days since last bet ", med_iqr(persons_raw$Recency, 0), "; platforms ", med_iqr(persons_raw$NumPlatforms, 0),
  "; year began betting ", med_iqr(persons_raw$YearBegin, 0), ".")

kable(tab1, caption = paste0("Table 3. Descriptive statistics for the nondemographic covariates and person-level betting tendencies (N = ", nrow(persons_raw), ")")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows("Covariates", 1, nrow(tab1_cov)) %>%
  pack_rows("Person-level betting tendencies (across the four slates)", nrow(tab1_cov) + 1, nrow(tab1)) %>%
  footnote(general = c("Covariates are untransformed. Betting frequency, typical bet amount, days since last bet, and number of platforms were log(1 + x) transformed in the models and correlations.",
    "The n for each tendency varies because a share is undefined for a participant who never took that kind of bet."))
```

Participants took `r pct(mean(bets$Took))` of the bets offered (`r fmt2(mean(blocks$NumBets))` bets per slip). `r sum(blocks$NumBets == 0)` of the `r format(nrow(blocks), big.mark = ",")` slips (`r pct(mean(blocks$NumBets == 0))`) contained no bet. `r n_shown` of the `r nrow(persons_raw)` participants (`r pct(n_shown / nrow(persons_raw))`) saw the probabilities.

The mean DOSPERT score was `r fmt2(mean(persons_raw$DOSPERTMean))`. For comparison, Blais and Weber (2006, Table 2) report a summed score of 20.67 (*SD* = 8.51) over the six financial items for English-speaking North American adults, or `r fmt2(20.67 / 6)` (`r fmt2(8.51 / 6)`) per item. The mean ABIS nonplanning score was `r fmt2(mean(persons_raw$BISMean))`.

Medians (interquartile ranges) of the betting-habit measures: `r med_iqr_txt`

```{r wager-check}
wager_check <- blocks %>%
  filter(TotalStake > 0) %>%
  mutate(Wagers = if_else(Parlay == 1, 1L, NumBets)) %>%
  group_by(PROLIFIC_PID) %>%
  summarise(MeanWager = sum(TotalStake) / sum(Wagers), .groups = "drop") %>%
  inner_join(persons_raw %>% select(PROLIFIC_PID, Typical.Bet), by = "PROLIFIC_PID")

ct_wager <- cor.test(log1p(wager_check$MeanWager), log1p(wager_check$Typical.Bet))

sp_wager <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(wager_check$MeanWager, wager_check$Typical.Bet, method = "spearman"))
```

Among the `r nrow(wager_check)` participants who placed at least one wager, the mean amount wagered per bet in the task correlated with the reported typical bet amount at *r* = `r nz(fmt2(unname(ct_wager$estimate)))`, 95% CI [`r nz(fmt2(ct_wager$conf.int[1]))`, `r nz(fmt2(ct_wager$conf.int[2]))`] (both log(1 + *x*) transformed).

```{r bet-odds}
taken_odds <- bets %>%
  filter(Took == 1) %>%
  mutate(Side = case_when(Favorite > 0 ~ "Favorite", Favorite < 0 ~ "Underdog", Over > 0 ~ "Over", TRUE ~ "Under"))

ml_taken <- taken_odds %>% filter(BetType == "Moneyline")

ml_person <- ml_taken %>% group_by(PROLIFIC_PID) %>% summarise(FavShare = mean(Favorite > 0), .groups = "drop")

team_range <- menu %>% filter(BetType != "Moneyline") %>% summarise(lo = min(q), hi = max(q))
```

Every spread and totals bet had a no-vig win probability between `r nz(fmt2(team_range$lo))` and `r nz(fmt2(team_range$hi))`. Moneyline favorites made up `r pct(mean(ml_taken$Favorite > 0))` of the moneyline bets taken (mean no-vig win probability = `r nz(fmt2(mean(ml_taken$q[ml_taken$Favorite > 0])))`), and underdogs `r pct(mean(ml_taken$Favorite < 0))` (mean = `r nz(fmt2(mean(ml_taken$q[ml_taken$Favorite < 0])))`). Of the `r nrow(ml_person)` participants who took a moneyline bet, `r sum(ml_person$FavShare == 1)` took only favorites, `r sum(ml_person$FavShare == 0)` took only underdogs, and `r sum(ml_person$FavShare > 0 & ml_person$FavShare < 1)` took both. The person-level means for favorites, overs, and parlaying are in Table 3.

## Correlations

```{r cor-cov}
tab3 <- cor_table(tendencies, cov_names, row_labels = paste0(seq_along(cov_names), ". ", cov_labels[cov_names]), col_labels = as.character(seq_along(cov_names)))

n_sig_b1 <- sum(str_detect(tab3, "\\*"))

max_r_b1 <- max(abs(as.numeric(str_remove(str_replace(tab3[tab3 != ""], "^(-?)\\.", "\\10."), "\\*"))))
```

`r n_sig_b1` of the `r choose(length(cov_names), 2)` correlations among the covariates were significant after Holm correction, and the largest was |*r*| = `r nz(fmt2(max_r_b1))` (Table B1, Appendix B).

```{r tab-5}
tab4 <- cor_table(tendencies, cov_names, names(tendency_labels), row_labels = cov_labels[cov_names], col_labels = tendency_labels, by = "col")

n_sig_tab4 <- sum(str_detect(tab4, "\\*"))

sig_tab4 <- which(matrix(str_detect(tab4, "\\*"), nrow = nrow(tab4)), arr.ind = TRUE)

sig_tab4_txt <- if (nrow(sig_tab4) == 0) "none" else paste0(rownames(tab4)[sig_tab4[, 1]], " with ", tolower(colnames(tab4)[sig_tab4[, 2]]), " (r = ", sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", str_remove(tab4[sig_tab4], "\\*")), ")", collapse = "; ")

max_r_tab4 <- max(abs(as.numeric(str_remove(str_replace(tab4, "^(-?)\\.", "\\10."), "\\*"))), na.rm = TRUE)

kable(tab4, caption = "Table 5. Correlations between covariates and person-level betting tendencies") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = "Pearson correlations, pairwise complete. * Holm-adjusted p < .05 within each column (17 correlations per betting tendency).")
```

`r n_sig_tab4` of the `r length(tab4)` correlations were significant after Holm correction within each column (`r sig_tab4_txt`).

## Predicting Which Bets Participants Took

```{r tab-7}
bet_metrics <- cv_metrics(bet_cv) %>%
  mutate(Model = factor(Model, bet_specs$Model)) %>%
  arrange(Model)

bet_comparisons <- tribble(~Comparison, ~a, ~b,
  "Covariates vs. menu (M3 vs. M1)", "M1 Menu", "M3 Menu + covariates",
  "Interactions vs. main effects (M4 vs. M3)", "M3 Menu + covariates", "M4 + interactions",
  "Preferences vs. menu (M5 vs. M1)", "M1 Menu", "M5 Menu + preferences",
  "Preferences vs. best covariate model (M5 vs. M3)", "M3 Menu + covariates", "M5 Menu + preferences",
  "Preferences vs. interaction model (M5 vs. M4)", "M4 + interactions", "M5 Menu + preferences",
  "Covariates added to preferences (M6 vs. M5)", "M5 Menu + preferences", "M6 Preferences + covariates") %>%
  mutate(v = map2(a, b, ~ elpd_diff(bet_cv, .x, .y)), d = map_dbl(v, "d"), se = map_dbl(v, "se"))

bet_vs_best <- elpd_vs_best(bet_cv)

bet_metrics <- bet_metrics %>% left_join(bet_vs_best %>% mutate(Model = factor(Model, bet_specs$Model)), by = "Model")

best_bet <- as.character(bet_metrics$Model[bet_metrics$Best])

r2_bet <- setNames(bet_metrics$`CV pseudo-R²`, as.character(bet_metrics$Model))

auc_bet <- setNames(bet_metrics$AUC, as.character(bet_metrics$Model))

cmp_bet <- bet_comparisons %>% select(Comparison, d, se)

# Gains measured from the same baseline (M1): preferences added to the menu vs. covariates added to the menu
gain_ratio <- cmp_bet$d[str_detect(cmp_bet$Comparison, "M5 vs. M1")] / cmp_bet$d[str_detect(cmp_bet$Comparison, "M3 vs. M1")]

bet_metrics %>%
  transmute(Model = str_extract(Model, "^M\\d"),
    `ΔELPD from best (SE)` = if_else(Best, "0.0 (best)", paste0(formatC(d_best, format = "f", digits = 1), " (", formatC(se_best, format = "f", digits = 1), ")")),
    `Pseudo-R²` = r2z(`CV pseudo-R²`), AUC = r2z(AUC)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Table 7. Out-of-sample prediction of which bets were taken") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = "Each participant's held-out slate was predicted from a model fit to that participant's other three slates and to all other participants' data. ΔELPD = difference in summed held-out log predictive density from the best model; SE computed over held-out slips. Pseudo-R² = 1 − (held-out log likelihood of the model / held-out log likelihood of a base-rate model). AUC = area under the receiver operating characteristic curve.")

bet_comparisons %>%
  transmute(Comparison, `ΔELPD (SE)` = paste0(formatC(d, format = "f", digits = 1), " (", formatC(se, format = "f", digits = 1), ")")) %>%
  kable(caption = "Model comparisons reported in the text (Analysis 1)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = "Positive = the second model predicts held-out choices better. Differences larger than about 2 SE are reliable.")
```

Bet characteristics alone (M1): pseudo-*R*² = `r r2z(r2_bet["M1 Menu"])`, AUC = `r r2z(auc_bet["M1 Menu"])`. Covariates alone (M2): pseudo-*R*² = `r r2z(r2_bet["M2 Covariates"])`, AUC = `r r2z(auc_bet["M2 Covariates"])`. M3 vs. M1: `r d_txt(cmp_bet, "M3 vs. M1")`. M4 vs. M3: `r d_txt(cmp_bet, "M4 vs. M3")`. M5 vs. M1: `r d_txt(cmp_bet, "M5 vs. M1")`, `r formatC(gain_ratio, format = "f", digits = 1)` times the gain from the covariates (M3 vs. M1). M5 vs. M3: `r d_txt(cmp_bet, "M5 vs. M3")`; M5 pseudo-*R*² = `r r2z(r2_bet["M5 Menu + preferences"])`, AUC = `r r2z(auc_bet["M5 Menu + preferences"])`. M6 vs. M5: `r d_txt(cmp_bet, "M6 vs. M5")`.

```{r m5-values}
m5 <- bet_fits[["M5 Menu + preferences"]]

menu_pars <- c("WinProb10", "Favorite", "Over", "Shown", "WinProb10:Shown")

menu_labels <- c(WinProb10 = "Win probability (+10 points)", Favorite = "Favorite vs. underdog", Over = "Over vs. under",
  Shown = "Probabilities shown", `WinProb10:Shown` = "Win probability × probabilities shown")

p_int_m5 <- plogis(fixef(m5)["Intercept", "Estimate"])

pref_pars <- c(Intercept = "Overall appetite (more bets)", WinProb10 = "Taste for likely winners", Favorite = "Taste for favorites",
  Over = "Taste for overs", Totals = "Taste for totals bets")

cor_m5 <- VarCorr(m5)$PROLIFIC_PID$cor

r_app_win <- cor_m5["Intercept", "Estimate", "WinProb10"]

r_other_max <- max(abs(c(cor_m5["WinProb10", "Estimate", "Favorite"], cor_m5["Intercept", "Estimate", "Favorite"],
  cor_m5["Intercept", "Estimate", "Over"], cor_m5["WinProb10", "Estimate", "Over"], cor_m5["Favorite", "Estimate", "Over"])))

# Share of each preference's between-person variance explained by the covariates (M6 vs. M5)
tab10 <- tibble(par = names(pref_pars), Preference = pref_pars) %>%
  mutate(sd_m5 = map(par, ~ VarCorr(m5)$PROLIFIC_PID$sd[.x, ]),
    `Between-person SD (M5) [95% CrI]` = map_chr(sd_m5, ~ paste0(fmt2(.x["Estimate"]), " [", fmt2(.x["Q2.5"]), ", ", fmt2(.x["Q97.5"]), "]")),
    r2 = map(par, ~ r2_between(m5, bet_fits[["M6 Preferences + covariates"]], paste0("sd_PROLIFIC_PID__", .x))),
    `Explained by covariates [95% CrI]` = map_chr(r2, pct_ci))

r2b <- function(p) tab10$r2[[which(tab10$par == p)]]


# Favorite-vs-underdog (and over-vs-under) odds ratio for a participant 1 SD above and below the average preference.
# Favorite and Over are coded ±0.5, so exp(b + u) is that participant's odds ratio for one side over the other.
side_or <- function(fit, par) {
  b <- fixef(fit)[par, "Estimate"]; s <- VarCorr(fit)$PROLIFIC_PID$sd[par, "Estimate"]
  c(avg = exp(b), above = exp(b + s), below = exp(b - s), ratio = exp(s))
}

fav_sd <- side_or(m5, "Favorite")
```

Values reported for M5 (Table 8): intercept `r or_txt(m5, "Intercept")` (about a `r round(100 * p_int_m5)`% chance); NFL spread `r or_txt(m5, mt("NFL Spread"))`; NFL moneyline `r or_txt(m5, mt("NFL Moneyline"))`; CFP totals `r or_txt(m5, mt("CFB Totals"))`; bet intercept `r sd_txt(m5, "OptionID", "Intercept")`; win probability `r or_txt(m5, "WinProb10")`; favorite `r or_txt(m5, "Favorite")`; over `r or_txt(m5, "Over")`; probabilities shown `r or_txt(m5, "Shown")`; win probability × probabilities shown `r or_txt(m5, "WinProb10:Shown")`. The same interaction in M1: `r or_txt(bet_fits[["M1 Menu"]], "WinProb10:Shown")` (Table B2).

Between-participant SDs: overs `r sd_txt(m5, "PROLIFIC_PID", "Over")`; favorites `r sd_txt(m5, "PROLIFIC_PID", "Favorite")`; appetite `r sd_txt(m5, "PROLIFIC_PID", "Intercept")`; likely winners `r sd_txt(m5, "PROLIFIC_PID", "WinProb10")`; totals `r sd_txt(m5, "PROLIFIC_PID", "Totals")`. A participant 1 SD above the average favorite preference had about `r formatC(fav_sd["above"], format = "f", digits = 1)` times the odds of taking the favorite rather than the underdog; 1 SD below average, OR = `r fmt2(fav_sd["below"])`. Correlations among the four main preferences: |*r*| ≤ `r nz(fmt2(r_other_max))`, except appetite with likely winners (*r* = `r nz(fmt2(r_app_win))`). Slip SD = `r fmt2(VarCorr(m5)$Block$sd["Intercept", "Estimate"])`. Variance explained by the covariates (M6 vs. M5): appetite `r r2_med(r2b("Intercept"))` (95% CrI `r r2_ci(r2b("Intercept"))`), likely winners `r r2_med(r2b("WinProb10"))` (`r r2_ci(r2b("WinProb10"))`), favorites `r r2_med(r2b("Favorite"))` (`r r2_ci(r2b("Favorite"))`), overs `r r2_med(r2b("Over"))` (`r r2_ci(r2b("Over"))`).

## Relationship Between Single-Bet Preference and Parlaying

The joint model refits M5 and P4 together and estimates the correlations between their participant effects. All `r n_distinct(persons$PROLIFIC_PID)` participants are included; the `r n_distinct(persons$PROLIFIC_PID) - n_distinct(parlay_d$PROLIFIC_PID)` who never took two or more bets in a slate contribute only to the bet-level part.

```{r joint-fit, results='hide'}
# Combined data: bet rows feed the Took response, slip rows feed the Parlay response (brms subset())
joint_d <- bind_rows(
  bets %>% transmute(PROLIFIC_PID, Block, OptionID = as.character(OptionID), MarketType = as.character(MarketType), WinProb10, Favorite, Over, Totals, Shown, Took, is_bet = TRUE),
  parlay_d %>% transmute(PROLIFIC_PID, Block, Scenario = as.character(Scenario), Legs, LegWinProb10, Shown, Parlay, is_parlay = TRUE)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(is_bet, is_parlay), ~ coalesce(.x, FALSE)),
    OptionID = coalesce(OptionID, first(na.omit(OptionID))), MarketType = coalesce(MarketType, levels(bets$MarketType)[1]),
    Scenario = coalesce(Scenario, scenario_levels[1]),
    across(c(WinProb10, Favorite, Over, Totals, Shown, Took, Legs, LegWinProb10, Parlay), ~ coalesce(.x, 0)),
    MarketType = factor(MarketType, levels(bets$MarketType)), Scenario = factor(Scenario, scenario_levels))

contrasts(joint_d$MarketType) <- contr.sum(6)

contrasts(joint_d$Scenario) <- contr.sum(4)

# The (1 | p | PROLIFIC_PID) terms share the label p, so the participant effects of both responses are drawn jointly
# and their correlations are estimated. Each response is fit only to its own rows (subset()).
joint_formula <- bf(as.formula(paste("Took | subset(is_bet) ~", menu_terms, "+ (1 | OptionID) + (1 | Block) + (1 + WinProb10 + Favorite + Over + Totals | p | PROLIFIC_PID)")), family = bernoulli()) +
  bf(as.formula(paste("Parlay | subset(is_parlay) ~", slip_terms, "+ (1 | p | PROLIFIC_PID)")), family = bernoulli()) +
  set_rescor(FALSE)

joint_fit <- brm(joint_formula, data = joint_d,
  prior = prior(normal(0, 1), class = b, resp = "Took") + prior(normal(0, 1), class = b, resp = "Parlay") +
    prior(exponential(1), class = sd, resp = "Took") + prior(exponential(1), class = sd, resp = "Parlay") + prior(lkj(2), class = cor),
  chains = n_chains, iter = 6 * n_iter, control = list(adapt_delta = .99, max_treedepth = 12), seed = 1, refresh = 0, init = 0,
  file = paste0(modelPath, "joint_M5_P4_6long"), file_refit = "on_change")  # six times the iterations of the other fits (24,000), with adapt_delta = .99 and max_treedepth = 12
```

```{r joint-results}
# Latent correlations between each M5 preference and the P4 parlay tendency, from the joint model
jd <- as_draws_df(joint_fit)

joint_cor <- function(term) {
  cands <- c(paste0("cor_PROLIFIC_PID__Took_", term, "__Parlay_Intercept"), paste0("cor_PROLIFIC_PID__Parlay_Intercept__Took_", term))
  col <- intersect(cands, names(jd))
  stopifnot(length(col) == 1)
  jd[[col]]
}

m5_fit <- bet_fits[["M5 Menu + preferences"]]

p4_fit <- parlay_fits[["P4 Menu + preference"]]

# Check: correlation of the participant deviations from the separate M5 and P4 fits, draw by draw
re_draws <- function(fit, term) {
  dr <- subset_draws(as_draws_matrix(fit), variable = paste0("^r_PROLIFIC_PID\\[.*,", term, "\\]$"), regex = TRUE)
  out <- matrix(as.numeric(dr), nrow = nrow(dr))
  colnames(out) <- sub("^r_PROLIFIC_PID\\[(.*),.*\\]$", "\\1", colnames(dr))
  out
}

p4_int <- re_draws(p4_fit, "Intercept")

link_ids <- colnames(p4_int)

link_res <- imap_dfr(pref_pars, function(lab, term) {
  jr <- joint_cor(term)
  a <- re_draws(m5_fit, term)[, link_ids, drop = FALSE]
  n <- min(nrow(a), nrow(p4_int))
  sep_r <- vapply(seq_len(n), function(i) cor(a[i, ], p4_int[i, ]), numeric(1))
  tibble(term = term, Preference = lab, r = median(jr), lo = unname(quantile(jr, .025)), hi = unname(quantile(jr, .975)), pd = mean(jr > 0),
    sr = median(sep_r), sr_lo = unname(quantile(sep_r, .025)), sr_hi = unname(quantile(sep_r, .975)))
}) %>%
  mutate(credible = lo > 0 | hi < 0)

ci_str <- function(r, lo, hi) paste0(nz(fmt2(r)), " [", nz(fmt2(lo)), ", ", nz(fmt2(hi)), "]")

link_res %>%
  transmute(Preference, `Joint model: r [95% CrI]` = ci_str(r, lo, hi), `Probability r > 0` = nz(fmt2(pd)),
    `Separate fits: r [95% CrI]` = ci_str(sr, sr_lo, sr_hi)) %>%
  kable(caption = "Correlations between the M5 stable preferences and the P4 parlay tendency (reported in the text)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  footnote(general = "Joint model: posterior median of the latent correlation between participants' random effects, with 95% credible interval; Probability r > 0 = share of posterior draws above zero. Separate fits: median across draws of the correlation between the participants' M5 and P4 deviations from the separately fitted models. Exploratory; no correction for multiple comparisons.")

excluded_ids <- setdiff(persons$PROLIFIC_PID, link_ids)

app_all <- ranef(m5_fit)$PROLIFIC_PID[, "Estimate", "Intercept"]
```

Participants with parlay data had a mean M5 appetite deviation of `r fmt2(mean(app_all[names(app_all) %in% link_ids]))`, compared with `r fmt2(mean(app_all[names(app_all) %in% excluded_ids]))` for those without. The largest squared correlation was *R*² = `r nz(fmt2(max(link_res$r)^2))`.

# Appendix A: Convergence Diagnostics

```{r tab-a1}
diag_tbl <- function(fits) {
  imap_dfr(fits, function(fit, nm) {
    s <- summary(fit)
    rh <- c(s$fixed$Rhat, unlist(map(s$random, "Rhat")))
    ess <- c(s$fixed$Bulk_ESS, unlist(map(s$random, "Bulk_ESS")))
    tibble(Model = nm, `Max R-hat` = fmt3(max(rh, na.rm = TRUE)), `Min bulk ESS` = round(min(ess, na.rm = TRUE)),
      `Divergent transitions` = sum(nuts_params(fit) %>% filter(Parameter == "divergent__") %>% pull(Value)))
  })
}

bind_rows(diag_tbl(bet_fits), diag_tbl(parlay_fits), diag_tbl(list(`Joint M5 + P4` = joint_fit))) %>%
  kable(caption = "Table A1. Convergence diagnostics for the full-data models") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = "striped", full_width = FALSE) %>%
  pack_rows("Analysis 1: Taking a bet", 1, nrow(bet_specs)) %>%
  pack_rows("Analysis 2: Parlaying", nrow(bet_specs) + 1, nrow(bet_specs) + nrow(parlay_specs)) %>%
  pack_rows("Exploratory analysis: Single-bet preferences and parlaying", nrow(bet_specs) + nrow(parlay_specs) + 1, nrow(bet_specs) + nrow(parlay_specs) + 1) %>%
  footnote(general = "ESS = effective sample size. The 11 main models used four chains of 4,000 iterations (2,000 warmup); the joint model used four chains of 24,000 iterations (12,000 warmup).")
```
